narr: A trough of low pressure brough some widely scattered heavy showers to RI and southeast MA which caused some localized flash flooding problems in MA and RI.
ev: In Fall River, Brayton Ave at Reeves St was flooded and impassable. A section of Brayton Ave by the bus terminal was heavily flooded.
lsr: Brayton Avenue at Reeves Street - flooded/impassable. Section of Brayton Avenue by bus terminal flooding somewhat heavily. Reports relayed via amateur radio.
